description: loop.questions on a loop parked on a step's block of questions (S76): every question the step asked, oldest first, answered ones carrying the answer already given and the pending ones none, so a reopened chat shows ONE block, resumes where the person left off and never asks again what was answered. Answers is the declared option set ([] means free text). A loop with no parked question answers an empty list, never an error.

questions.prompt: There is no AGENTS.md in this workspace. Which direction should the goal capture?
The capture documents are written, but goal creation failed. How should the goal be filed?
